svg.aria-label: Exploration sidebar redesign at its real 360 pixel width: one 'one row per' unit selector replacing the mode segments plus the rank dropdown, one list whose chrome is invariant, a detail view that replaces the list, and the loading, empty, error, capped and messy-data states.
svg.text: Exploration sidebar — one unit selector, one list, one detail
Drawn at the shipped 360 px column width. Every name, count and span is read from the shipped snapshot: Maastrichtian, whole map in view (5,064 occurrences · 2,439 localities · 379 genera).
A · DEFAULT LIST — ONE ROW PER GENUS
B · ONE ROW PER OCCURRENCE (CAPPED)
C · ONE ROW PER LOCALITY
D · A ROW OPENED — DETAIL REPLACES LIST

g.text: Showing the first 300 of 379 — zoom in to narrow the view.
2,898 occurrences · 57% of the records in view

svg.text: Rows are ordered by count, so the 300-row cap cuts the rare tail, not the alphabet. Left rule = clade tint (SPEC-015); the clade is also named in words.
The not-classified bucket is pinned above the cap: at genus it holds 2,898 of 5,064 records and today falls at position 380 — past the cap, invisible.

g.text: Showing the first 300 of 5,064 — zoom in to narrow the view.
66–72.2 Ma ≈ · Ojo Alamo · SMP Loc. 410b, Willow…
66–72.2 Ma ≈ · Ojo Alamo · SMP loc. 389b, Willow…
66–72.2 Ma ≈ · Barun Goyot · Turtle Graveyard loc…
66–72.2 Ma ≈ · Formation not recorded · Pajcha Pata
66–83.6 Ma ≈ · Hell Creek · Lead Slug Hill 1

svg.text: The chrome is identical to A. Only the row body changes: an occurrence names its formation and collection instead of a count.
"Formation not recorded" is the explicit missing label — the row is never dropped and never left blank (charter §2).

g.text: Showing the first 300 of 2,439 — zoom in to narrow the view.

svg.text: A locality is a place, not a clade, so it carries no clade rule — the tint is never applied to something that is not a clade (charter §4).
Collection names run long and are truncated to the column, with the full name in the row's title (charter §6).

g.text: Esc, or the link above, returns to the list —
scrolled to this row, with the row marked.

svg.text: The unit selector never moves: the user always knows what a row is, even inside a detail. The back link names the list it returns to.
Selecting a point on the map lands here too — the map keeps its focus/dim, so the detail is evidence, not a second copy of it.
E · LOADING A STAGE
F · EMPTY — NO OCCURRENCES AT THIS AGE
G · ERROR — STAGE FAILED TO LOAD
H · EMPTY IN VIEW (RECOVERABLE)

Names wrap to one line and truncate with the
full string in the row's title — never clipped.
Mode and rank were two controls answering
one question. Five units, one flat set, one
choice. No control appears or disappears.
Header, count, cap notice, empty-in-view and
highlight are the same code for every unit.
Only the two lines of a row body differ.
A detail no longer pushes the list down a
360 px scroll column. Back is one action and
restores the scroll position and the row.
